Mapper specs list ops by name; each op transforms one or more columns. Authoring guide: [Mapper specs](../06-authoring/mappers.md).

| Op | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `apply_transforms` | Run a public-library transform chain inside a mapper spec. |
| `case_map` | Apply upper/lower/title case to a column. |
| `hash_id` | Deterministically hash an identifier column using a per-pipeline salt. |
| `legacy_select` | Project `df` exactly like a legacy mapper's `select(...)`. |
| `literal` | Overwrite a column with a constant value. |
| `passthrough` | Return the DataFrame unchanged. |
| `regex_replace` | Regex substitution on one column. |
| `translate_by_concept` | Apply a semantic vocabulary translation to one column. |
| `translate_by_dict` | Apply a value dictionary to one column. |

## apply_transforms

Run a public-library transform chain inside a mapper spec.

## case_map

Apply upper/lower/title case to a column.

| Param | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `column` | Column to transform. |
| `mode` | One of `'upper'`, `'lower'`, `'title'`. |

## hash_id

Deterministically hash an identifier column using a per-pipeline salt.

| Param | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `column` | Column to hash. |
| `salt_key` | Key in `ctx.secrets` whose value is the per-pipeline salt string. Defaults to `'id_salt'`. |
| `algorithm` | Hash algorithm. Currently only `'sha256'` is supported. |
| `output_length` | Optional integer — truncate the hex digest to this many characters. Defaults to the CDM's harmonised width for the column's identifier role when available; otherwise the full digest is retained. |

## legacy_select

Project `df` exactly like a legacy mapper's `select(...)`.

| Param | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `columns` | Ordered list. Each item is either a bare column name (`unmapped['X']` — output name `X`) or a one-key mapping `{OUT: <expr>}` where `<expr>` is one of: `{col: X}` `unmapped['X']` / `col('X')` `{col: X, cast: T}` `col('X').cast(T)` `{encrypt: X}` `cf.encrypt_id_udf(unmapped['X'])` `{encrypt: X, suffix: S}` `cf.encrypt_id_udf(concat(X, lit(S)))` `{dict: D, col: X}` `coalesce(D[upper(col(X))], col(X))` `{dict: D, col: X, upper: false}` `coalesce(D[col(X)], col(X))` `{dict: D, col: X, fallback: none}` `D[upper(col(X))]` (no pass-through) `{dict: D, col: X, fallback: {lit: V}}` `coalesce(D[upper(col(X))], lit(V))` `{coalesce: [<expr>, ...]}` `coalesce(...)` of sub-expressions, where a sub-expression may also be `{nonblank: X}` = `when(col(X) != '', col(X))` or `{dict_only: D, col: X}` = `D[upper(col(X))]` `{lit: V}` `lit(V)` `{updated: true}` `cf.get_current_time_udf()` (America/New_York) `{source: true}` `lit(partner.upper())` `{udf: NAME, args: [X, ...]}` a named function from `MAPPER_UDFS` |
| `pre_join` | Optional `geocoding` — first reproduce the legacy address mappers' `joined_geocoding` frame (left joins of the `FULL_GEOCODING` reference on `ADDRESS_ZIP9` and, for ZIP5-only rows, on `ADDRESS_ZIP5`); projected columns then resolve against it. |
| `append_additional_fields` | Optional `{join_field: X}` — reproduces legacy `cf.append_additional_fields`: when the input carries more than `len(columns) - 3` columns, every input column *not* already projected is appended (inner join on `X`, which legacy carried as the hidden `JOIN_FIELD`). Otherwise nothing is appended. Legacy re-read the deduplicated file with `inferSchema="true"` for the appended columns, so they carry inferred-type text (`legacy_infer_schema_view`). |

## literal

Overwrite a column with a constant value.

| Param | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `column` | Column to overwrite (created when absent). |
| `value` | Constant value. Any JSON-compatible scalar. |

## passthrough

Return the DataFrame unchanged.

## regex_replace

Regex substitution on one column.

| Param | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `column` | Column to transform. |
| `pattern` | Regex pattern to match. |
| `replacement` | Replacement string (may reference groups as `$1` etc.). |

## translate_by_concept

Apply a semantic vocabulary translation to one column.

| Param | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `column` | Column whose values should be translated. Also the default write-back column unless `target_column` overrides it. |
| `vocabulary` | Name of the registered `VocabularyHandle` (e.g. `'omop_concept'`, `'loinc'`). |
| `match` | Column *in the vocabulary view* to match against. Defaults to the vocabulary handle's `code_column`. |
| `target` | Column *in the vocabulary view* whose value replaces the source. Defaults to the vocabulary handle's `code_column` — effectively a filter-by-existence when target == match. |
| `target_column` | Optional output column name (defaults to `column`). |
| `keep_unmatched` | When `True` (default), unmatched values pass through unchanged. When `False`, unmatched rows are dropped. |
| `domain_filter` | Optional list of values used to pre-filter the vocabulary view on its `domain_column` (e.g. `['Condition']` for the OMOP CONCEPT domain). Ignored when the vocabulary has no `domain_column`. |
| `case_sensitive` | When `False` (default), match/target comparison is case-insensitive. Both sides are `upper()`-normalised for the join. |

## translate_by_dict

Apply a value dictionary to one column.

| Param | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `column` | Column to translate. |
| `dict` | Name of the `dict[str, str]` in the pipeline's `dictionaries` module. Convention: `<table>_<column>_dict`. |
| `default` | Optional literal value to fall back on when the source value is not in the dict. When omitted, unmatched values pass through unchanged (matches legacy behaviour). |
| `keep_null` | When `True` (default), null input stays null. When `False`, null maps to `default` if provided. |
